{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# First, drop rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Then deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq in descending order, then drop duplicates
data = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
data = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute the fraction who responded
fraction_responded = control_moderate['responded'].mean()

# Output result
fraction_responded"}
